Fit one growth curve to daily counts by maximum likelihood

Source: R/incidence_ensemble.R
fit_growth_incidence.Rd

Poisson or negative-binomial likelihood for the daily counts x of a segment, with mean given by growth_incidence(). Parameters are optimised on the scale \((\log y_0, \log(K - y_0), \log\gamma[, \log\phi])\) from a small grid of starting values.

Usage

fit_growth_incidence(
  x,
  model = c("logistic", "gompertz", "richards"),
  family = c("poisson", "negbin"),
  beta = 1.5,
  start = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Daily counts of the segment (local times 1, ..., length(x)).

model

Growth model.

family

"poisson" or "negbin".

beta

Richards shape (held fixed).

start

Optional warm start on the unconstrained scale (e.g. par of a previous fit), tried in addition to the default grid.

Value

A list with coef, loglik, aic, bic, k (number of estimated parameters), fitted, model, family, beta, n.
